title: RWANG Document Graph
description: Schema 2.0.0 for docs/.doc-graph.json — a GENERATED PROJECTION of the Entity Registry plus discovered source artifacts (CR-2026-08-20-01 A2). It is never a source of truth and never hand-edited. Graphs written against schema 1.x are readable in explicit 'legacy' mode only and MUST NOT be promoted as current evidence. Breaking changes vs 1.x: node id pattern gains dom|feat|diag|testspec|rel prefixes; node types gain domain/feature/test_spec/diagram/release; edge type 'stale' removed (staleness is edge status, not a predicate); edges require contract_id/contract_version/semantic_hash; header requires source_ref + provenance; single writer.

version.description: Schema version (semver). This schema describes 2.x graphs.

generated_by.description: Single writer: only rwang:doc-graph writes the projection. doc-architect requests initialization through it.

source_ref.description: Checkout anchor this projection was generated from: commit SHA, or a content-digest of the full discovery set in no-VCS mode. Check #16 verifies it matches the current checkout.

coverage.description: Derived from reconciled stable-ID sets — never free-form percentage strings. Views the profile declares not_applicable are excluded from denominators ('declared absent' is not coverage).

id.description: Unique node identifier. Format: <type>:<identifier>. Requirement IDs are namespaced (req:<namespace>:<ID>).

defined_in.description: Document where this node is defined

doc_version.description: Machine-readable document version for governed document nodes. Content-hash change without a bump fails RWG-108.

doc_status.description: When a supersedes edge targets this document, doc_status MUST be 'superseded'.

status.description: Node status relative to last scan

last_verified.description: When this node was last verified as current

annotations.description: Structured annotations found in this code file

from.description: Source node ID (the from-side of the contract's canonical direction — inverse navigation is a query, never a second reverse edge)

type.description: Canonical predicate. 'stale' is NOT a predicate (use status). 'implements' edges MUST originate from code_file nodes; generated artifacts are never evidence sources.

contract_id.description: Reference to the governing contract in docs/registry/edge-contracts/

semantic_hash.description: sha256 of the NORMALIZED CONTRACT VERSION this edge was validated against (not a hash of the edge payload) — SPEC-5DRIVEN-01 §2.3

status.description: Edge health status. Staleness lives here — it is a state on the semantic edge, not an edge type.

reason.description: Explanation for stale/contradiction status. Required for contradicts edges.

source.description: The single from-side assertion source (RWG-207/208). 'manual' edges still pass full contract validation — the value marks provenance, not a bypass.

payload.description: Optional relationship data, validated against the contract's payload_schema

provenance.description: Audit metadata (CR §2.5). session_id/actor_id/run_id/timestamp never enter semantic_hash or exact-set reconciliation — regenerating the same checkout from another session reconciles identically.
